post.summary: Set your private display name and order for a provider account.
Save, reorder, delete or assign members to your private usage buckets.
Choose an available Worker or passive session source for this subscription account.
Read authorized Worker, session or account usage statistics, including metadata for unshared sessions on your Workers.
Preview the nominated usage document your Workers receive: the Hub-wide pair and your own pair. Labels are plain untrusted text; no session names, folders, account labels or member ids.
Read registered Worker usage metadata and optionally refresh its installed harness inventory.
